|translation='''Title:''' Garouf Lafoe.

'''Card text:'''
Adds 1 to the power of a starship he pilots. All of your characters at the same Tatooine location card are forfeit +1. All opponent's characters at the same Hoth location card are forfeit -1. May not use game text if at the same location card as a tax collector.

'''Lore:'''
A free trader who exports ice chunks from the rings of Ohann and Adriana, outer planets of the Tatoo system. Because ice is all he handles, Imperial taxes and bribes squeeze him, and business stays cold.
